title: Startup support for founders in Japan
seo_title: Start a Business in Japan｜Bilingual startup support: business plan, funding prep, back office, and professional introductions
description: Bilingual (English/Japanese) support for founders starting a business in Japan: business plan, funding preparation, accounting and back-office setup, Japanese business customs, and introductions to licensed professionals (judicial scriveners, administrative scriveners, tax accountants, labor consultants). Based in Tokyo, available online nationwide.
catch:
Start your business in Japan
with a partner who speaks both languages.
lead: Starting a company in Japan means navigating unfamiliar procedures, a different business culture, and a lot of paperwork in Japanese. COANA TOKYO is your single point of contact: we help you plan, set up your back office, understand how business is done here, and connect you with the right licensed professionals at the right time.
hero_note: Free consultation in English. Online nationwide, office in Minato-ku, Tokyo.

hero_facts.label: We coordinate the professionals you need

target.name: Founders planning to incorporate in Japan
target.text: You have a business idea and maybe a visa plan, but the incorporation process, bank accounts, taxes, and accounting rules are unclear.

target.name: Newly established companies
target.text: Your company exists on paper. Now you need invoices, bookkeeping, payroll preparation, and tools that work in Japanese and English.

target.name: Overseas companies opening in Japan
target.text: You are setting up a Japanese subsidiary or branch and need someone local who understands both the paperwork and the customs.

problems: You do not know which professional handles what: incorporation, visas, taxes, labor
Every form, bank, and government office communicates only in Japanese
You need a business plan for a visa, a loan, or investors, in a format Japan expects
Japanese invoicing, seals (hanko), payment terms, and bank transfers are confusing
You are not sure which accounting software and tools to use
You want someone who can answer practical questions quickly, in English

scheme.title: One bilingual point of contact
scheme.lead: COANA TOKYO organizes your plan, money, back office, and first customers, and coordinates licensed professionals for the work that Japanese law reserves for them. You talk to one team, in English.

points.name: A plan you can actually use
points.text: We help you write a business plan and financial projections that work for Japanese banks, subsidy programs, and visa applications.

points.name: The right professional, at the right time
points.text: Company registration, visas and permits, tax filing, and social insurance are handled by licensed specialists. We introduce them and keep the communication organized.

points.name: Support after launch, too
points.text: Bookkeeping, monthly numbers, marketing and sales setup. The questions keep coming after launch, and so do we.

scheme.note: COANA TOKYO is not a law firm, tax firm, or immigration office. Legal, tax, immigration, and social-insurance procedures are performed by licensed professionals we introduce you to.

features_lead: Choose only what you need. Everything is available in English and Japanese.

features.name: Business plan support
features.text: We structure your idea, target customers, revenue model, budget, and cash-flow projections into a plan that Japanese banks, subsidy programs, and visa applications expect.

features.name: Funding preparation
features.text: We explain startup loans (e.g. Japan Finance Corporation), local government programs, and subsidies, and help you prepare the numbers and documents you will need.

features.name: Accounting and back-office setup
features.text: We choose and configure cloud accounting software, connect bank accounts and cards, and set up invoicing, expenses, and receipt rules that comply with Japanese requirements (invoice system, electronic record keeping).

features.name: Japanese business customs
features.text: Invoicing cycles and payment terms, company seals, business cards, bank transfers, contracts, and communication etiquette. We explain what matters and help you avoid common mistakes.

features.name: Professional introductions and coordination
features.text: Judicial scriveners (incorporation), administrative scriveners (visas, permits), tax accountants, labor consultants, and lawyers. We introduce the right person and keep everyone aligned.

features.name: First customers in Japan
features.text: Website, social media, sales process, and events designed for the Japanese market, so you can start building a customer base from day one.

message_title: Japan is a great place to build a business. It should not be a lonely one.
message:
Many founders from overseas arrive with a strong idea and plenty of energy, and then lose months to paperwork, language barriers, and not knowing who to ask. Having worked inside a cloud accounting company, a tax accounting firm, and startups, I know where those months go.
COANA TOKYO exists so you can spend that time on customers and products instead. We will handle the Japanese side, explain how things work here, and bring in the right professionals when you need them.

faqs.q: Can you handle my visa or company registration?
faqs.a: No. Visa and permit applications are performed by licensed administrative scriveners, and company registration by judicial scriveners. We introduce you to trusted partners and coordinate the process with them.

faqs.q: Do you file taxes or handle social insurance?
faqs.a: Tax filing and advice are reserved for licensed tax accountants, and social-insurance procedures for labor and social security attorneys. We set up your bookkeeping and connect you with the right professional for filings.
Yes. We communicate with you in English and handle Japanese-language documents, tools, and conversations with professionals and banks on your behalf.

faqs.q: Can you help before I arrive in Japan?
faqs.a: Yes. Planning, projections, and the roadmap can all be done online before you arrive. We also prepare the materials you will need once you are here.

faqs.q: Do you work with sole proprietors and freelancers?
faqs.a: Yes. We support individuals as well as companies, and help you decide which structure fits your situation.
It depends on scope. After a free consultation we send a quote. Partial engagements, such as only the business plan or only the accounting setup, are welcome.
